resultBasis: Latest result for each unique engine/test from the initial static-site run and focused checks of the final build. The initial run had failures, retained below. This is a combined result, not a green full-suite rerun. Remote CI verifies the complete suite separately.
environment: Windows, local built Astro site at http://127.0.0.1:4322, one Playwright worker

platformNotes.description: webkit on win32: the bare local MP4 decoded and advanced, then paused across its first loop. This case verifies the real application still fallback; uninterrupted native looping is unsupported in this measured environment.

Windows WebKit Media Foundation stops this real native MP4 after its first loop. This test verifies graceful fallback, not successful uninterrupted looping. The same stop was reproduced on a minimal video without application code.
